basis: The separate preregistered startup confirmation completes all 480 samples and 960 events and passes all three primary and six secondary numerical guards.
Two independent saved-evidence reviews accept the retained whole-helper system-CPU tradeoff; the original automatic accepted:false and workflow failure remain unchanged.
The first fresh comparison completes all eight stages, 6912 retrieval/search calls and 42 quality cells; all 1536 native and 768 component full-output pairs match.
Root strict saved-data recomputation and an independent complete-results review verify the immutable evidence without new product calls.
The recovery source has all nine CI jobs passing; publication still requires its own exact final-source CI and the remaining enforced release gates.
comparison_limits: Book exceeds claude-mem annotation recall and completeness in all six projection cells and has the highest packed-context MRR among the four component implementations.

Ai-memory exceeds Book annotation recall and completeness in all six projection cells. Billion exceeds Book recall in all six and completeness in the four 1024/2048-token cells; Book has small 512-token completeness advantages.

Fresh fixed-order native means increase in all six cells; five native p95 cells increase and component search p95 rises about 1.83%. These are retained descriptive results, not a balanced causal recall claim.

All quality gains/losses, timing/resources, larger Book native payload, small low-overlap groups and memory/setup boundary limitations remain in the linked complete evidence. No whole-product speed or memory ratio follows.
All questions are answerable from one public HotpotQA source; no generated-answer, hallucination, abstention or private-conversation claim follows.
